title: STRETCH WRAPPER MAINTENANCE
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.USMC.MARCORP I&L.MARINE CORPS INSTALLATIONS COMMAND.MCIWEST.COMMANDING GENERAL
detail_text: The Regional Contracting Office (RCO) - MCI WEST, Marine Corps Base, Camp Pendleton, CA, has a requirement to provide stretch wrapper maintenance support for Consolidated Material and Service Center (CMSC), Marine Corps Base (MCB) Camp Pendleton CA, the period of performance is expected to begin on 1 June 2026. The anticipated procurement will be a Firm-Fixed-Price contract. This is a pre-solicitation notice that a solicitation is scheduled to be released via SAM (www..gov) on or around 9 May 2026 . This is not a request for quotations. This announcement is a pre-solicitation notice and is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government, implied or otherwise, to issue a solicitation or award a contract. Set-aside status: Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business The North American Industry Classification Standard (NAICS) code for this project is 811310 (Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment – except Automotive and Electronic Repair and Maintenance) with a size standard of $12.5 M. In order for contractors to conduct business with the Department of Defense, the contractor must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database. Information on registering in SAM may be obtained by calling (866) 606-8220 or via the internet at http://www.sam.gov. When available, the solicitation documents for this project will be accessible via SAM.gov. No CDs or hard copies will be available. Offerors are responsible for checking the referenced page for any update(s) to the Notice. The Government is not responsible for any loss of internet connectivity or for an offerors’ inability to access the document posted at the referenced website.
